about.paragraph1: Frontend developer with <bold>+4 years of solid experience</bold> in ReactJS, TypeScript, and software architecture, focused on creating scalable and optimized solutions.
about.paragraph2: I carry a lot of enthusiasm with me. Currently, I have been seeking to expand my horizons with new challenges, studies, and causes to collaborate on. I believe my professional path is sustained by extracting the best from experiences, building relationships, and learning.

achievements: Developed the new version of the company's main SaaS product, from business rule conception to final implementation.
Led the development of robust frontend solutions using React.js, TypeScript, and RadixUI, ensuring code scalability and maintainability.
Collaborated with Backend teams (C#, MySQL) for API integration and data flow optimization.
Participated in migrating the infrastructure to AWS (Amplify, Route53, Bucket, RDS, EC2).

istic.companyTitle: SENAI Institute of Information and Communication Technology
achievements: Defined and structured Frontend architecture, including library selection (React.js, TypeScript, React Query).
Stakeholder management: Served as the focal point for clients and suppliers, conducting meetings and ensuring alignment.
Responsible for schedule management and effort estimates, contributing to project delivery within deadlines.
Developed a pre and post-trade risk simulation system.
Implemented features in ReactJs and Typescript.
